results.name: Monthly spending breakdown
results.question: Show my spending by category this month
results.expectedBehavior: Should GROUP BY account/category and SUM amounts. Expense = money going out = credit side for bank/cash accounts. Should filter by current month using value_date.

queries.description: Calculate total spending by category for the current month
queries.reasoning: The user wants to see their spending categorized for the current month. This query joins the posting and account tables to group postings by the debit account's name (which represents the category for spending) and sums the amounts. It filters for the current month and excludes duplicate and closing entries.
queries.sql:
SELECT
    a.name AS category,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending
FROM
    posting p
JOIN
    account a ON p.account_id = a.id
WHERE
    p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo'
    AND (p.posting_type IS NULL OR p.posting_type <> 'DUPLICATE')
    AND (p.description IS NULL OR p.description NOT ILIKE '%Closing%')
    AND p.value_date >= '2026-05-31T18:30:00.000Z'
    AND p.value_date < '2026-06-30T18:30:00.000Z'
GROUP BY
    a.name
ORDER BY
    total_spending DESC;

results.name: Store-level breakdown (needs account context)
results.question: Can you split my grocery spending by store?
results.expectedBehavior: Without selectedAccountId: Should ask for clarification OR attempt broad query. Store names should come from posting.description field, grouped.

queries.description: Split grocery spending by store, assuming store names are in the posting description and cash/bank accounts are credit accounts for spending.
queries.reasoning: To split grocery spending by store, I need to group postings by their description (assuming store names are in the description) and sum the amounts. I also need to filter for postings that represent spending from cash or bank accounts, which typically means these accounts are on the credit side of the transaction. I will exclude duplicate and closing postings.
queries.sql:
SELECT p.description AS store,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending
FROM posting p
WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo'
  AND (p.posting_type IS NULL OR p.posting_type <> 'DUPLICATE')
  AND (p.description IS NULL OR p.description NOT ILIKE '%Closing%')
  AND p.credit_account_id IN (
    SELECT a.id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.org_id = 'org_indian_demo'
      AND a.name ILIKE '%Cash%' OR a.name ILIKE '%Bank%'
  )
GROUP BY p.description
ORDER BY total_spending DESC;

results.name: Income query
results.question: How much income did I receive last month?
results.expectedBehavior: Income = money coming in = debit side for bank/cash accounts. Should filter by last month dates and SUM amounts where account_id (debit) is an asset account.

queries.description: Calculate total income received last month
queries.reasoning: To determine the total income received last month, I need to sum the 'amount' from all postings where the 'account_id' is classified as 'Income'. The date range for 'last month' is from April 30, 2026, 18:30:00.000Z to May 31, 2026, 18:30:00.000Z. I also need to filter out duplicate and closing postings and ensure the query is scoped to the user's organization.
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_income FROM posting p WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo' AND p.account_id IN (SELECT id FROM account WHERE org_id = 'org_indian_demo' AND classification = 'Income') AND (p.posting_type IS NULL OR p.posting_type <> 'DUPLICATE') AND (p.description IS NULL OR p.description NOT ILIKE '%Closing%') AND p.value_date >= '2026-04-30T18:30:00.000Z' AND p.value_date < '2026-05-31T18:30:00.000Z'

results.finalResponse: You received **$0** in income last month.
